propositions: review_interrupts metric is published dimensionless and loses the reason field (bound-exceeded vs signal-unavailable) that autodeploy.sh already stamps, making it impossible to distinguish routine bot busyness from broken health probes via CloudWatch alone

signal-unavailable (probe unreadable, deploys running blind) and bound-exceeded (normal deferral limit reached, drain check working) require opposite remediations but are indistinguishable in the current single rolled-up alarm

the implementation splits the marker counting into two separate dimensionless metrics (review_interrupts_bound_exceeded and review_interrupts_signal_unavailable) by filtering journal patterns in observability.sh, with a rolled-up total preserved for backward compatibility
two reason-scoped CloudWatch alarms replace the single alarm, each carrying only its own remediation, with signal-unavailable keeping the same 1-datapoint evaluation to remain promptly alerting
automated test verifies the three published metrics split correctly over a synthetic journal including the piranha case where all firings are bound-exceeded
terraform apply on infra/terraform is required to instantiate the new alarms; the intermediate state between merge and apply publishes new metrics but still alarms on the old rolled-up signal
